rules: Never invent a player character's voluntary actions, speech, emotions, beliefs, conclusions, resource use, or consent.
Accept free-form declarations; never restrict players to fixed choices.
Ask at most one clarification only when resolution would materially change without it.
Do not roll for automatic, routine, or impossible actions.
Failure creates a fair forward-moving complication and leaves meaningful choices open.
Private declarations and discoveries remain private to their authorized recipient.

records.title: Southern Hemlock Bridge and Lantern Road

content.description: An old timber bridge at Hemlock's forest edge, connected to Hemlock Village, the Lantern Road, and a rootway beneath the bridge.
content.current_situation: Blue motes gather beneath the southern rail and move against the wind; tracks end where their light begins.
content.tone: Luminous woodland mystery grounded in relationships, agency, and discoverable danger.

records.title: Luminous Ledger visual language
records.content: Midnight navy shadows, soft ivory folio panels, antique gold framing, cyan and restrained violet luminous accents, botanical and rabbit motifs, tactile premium storybook detail, and clear readable hierarchy.

content.scope: Character, crowd, architecture, location, technology, material-culture, and environmental artwork. The Luminous Ledger remains the separate interface authority.
content.world_era: Late-19th/early-20th-century-adjacent fantasy entering its own modernity; regional traditions evolve through precision craft, professional specialization, modernizing tailoring, and selective magical information technology.
content.hemlock_architecture: Clean, maintained, modest-scale Harengon settlement integrating ecological and biophilic construction, restrained Art Nouveau organic geometry, selected Chinese garden-space and threshold ideas, and living temperate-forest systems.
content.hemlock_anatomy: Humanlike faces without rabbit muzzles or human ears; true rabbit ears, compact rabbit tails, humanlike hands, rabbit-influenced semi-digitigrade lower legs and feet, and clothing engineered for the anatomy.
content.technology: Precision craft plus selective magical information technology; do not infer steampunk clutter, contemporary consumer-electronics shorthand, or open global infrastructure.
content.production_rule: Modernity before magic. Generate individual full-bleed assets for a defined gameplay/device role, preserve overlay space for shared presentation, reuse approved art when appropriate, and never promote generated work before explicit approval.

media_roles.wayfolio_location_record: Clean portrait location artwork used as media inside a discovered World record; never a fake device screen or precomposed UI.
media_roles.shared_ipad_exterior_approach: A mandatory separate 4:3 exterior, approach, or exterior-equivalent gameplay scene for every built location.
media_roles.shared_ipad_gameplay_zone: A 4:3 interior, activity, or functional-zone scene that contributes distinct playable information.
media_roles.shared_ipad_first_person_counter: A first-person customer view from the player side of a shop or service counter.
media_roles.shared_ipad_first_person_seated: A first-person seated-at-table view for dining or hospitality play.
media_roles.shared_ipad_first_person_table_service: A seated first-person view with a server taking an order when table service is supported.
media_roles.weather_time_state: A separately registered weather or lighting state that does not overwrite an earlier approved state.

identity_rules: Map assets by stable location ID plus semantic role, never by folder order or newest timestamp.

Quiet Shrine is the canonical location identity for stable location 4/32. Garden Shrine is a production filename and visual-routing alias only; do not create a separate Garden Shrine or Hemlock Forest Shrine location.
Main Shrine Grove remains a distinct sacred location.
Commons Plaza is stable location 2/32 and remains distinct from supplemental Market Street.
Market Street does not renumber the 32-location production sequence.
Root & Kettle is stable location 20/32: a bright daytime tea house and cafe plus community kitchen, not a tavern.
content.approval_rule: Folder presence alone is not authority. Explicit approval promotes a registered stable subject and semantic role to approved-current or approved-reference; player-facing retrieval must still filter status, visibility, and knowledge scope.
